title: K1 walks entrance to restroom in the AGI House twin
note: First rehearsal on the real scanned map: A* on the cleaned LiDAR occupancy grid, Booster's RL walking policy in MuJoCo follows 8 legs and arrives without touching a wall.
say: From the front door to the restroom, 20 metres, rehearsed in the twin before the real robot takes a step.
